Electromagnetic radiation occurs as waves and includes visible light, invisible light (such as infrared and ultraviolet), X-rays, microwaves and radio waves. The components of visible light can be memorised by using the mnemonic ROYGBIV: an abbreviation of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo and violet.
